```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```
#| execute:
  echo: false
```{r}
billboard |> 
  select(artist, track, date.entered, wk1:wk4)
```

```{r}
billboard |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = wk1)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Week 1 Rankings",
    subtitle = "Rankings for songs entering the Billboard chart (n = 317)",
    x = "Week 1 Rank",
    y = "Count"
  )
```
